name: Planet Finance borrow discount treats freshly borrowed principal as accrued interest
summary: PlanetDiscountDelegate.changeUserBorrowDiscount treats the growth of a borrower's stored balance since the last snapshot as interest and subtracts a discount share of it from the recorded debt, while GToken.borrowFresh raises the principal without refreshing that snapshot. After staking GAMMA to reach a 5% discount tier and supplying USDT collateral, the attacker alternated gUSDT borrow() with the public updateUserDiscount(). The discount was applied to new principal 76 times, cutting its recorded debt by 10,183.70 USDT before it repaid and redeemed.
notes: PlanetDiscountDelegator._setImplementation emitted NewImplementation(0xd8933477080675edfcfb287b6c97e2a20e826af5, 0x4c9ed6a7...), the second and last implementation change before the exploit; the gUSDT market's own implementation change (0x2f64203e at 28399780) is earlier.

Net USDT depletion of the gUSDT market 0x045e2df638ebec29130dd3be61161cba5f00a9c8 in the single exploit transaction, which nets the attacker's own collateral supply and repayment and equals the summed discountGiven of the 76 BorrowDiscountAccrued events to within 1e-12 USDT. The attacker received 10,124.78 USDT; the rest went to swap and flash-loan fees.
